interpretation: There is no single stable degradation signature across all three historical cases.

I4K5 has a strong common-mode Plan-to-Surface serialization defect: roughly 60% of measured scene-body characters are classified scene-entry explanatory preface in both arms even under a conservative classifier, while the independent judges still confirm structural Treatment gains.
I4E demonstrates that continuity/speaker-authorization debt can concentrate late, but removing that debt does not by itself restore broad whole-episode superiority.

I4C shows a distinct residual pattern: candidate wins are concentrated early while all middle/late human-comparison samples favor human material despite zero measured preface/meta/critical-continuity defects. The preregistered H-W1..W3 metrics do not fully explain this case.

A new prospective renderer intervention should not yet be chosen from one dominant signature. First isolate the residual I4C-style craft-drift dimension with a new preregistered diagnostic, then design a fresh prospective intervention.
